messages:
Sam J: Quick heads-up — I'm landing a small TF module refactor in staging now. It's mostly renaming outputs and tightening provider constraints to guard minor bump surprises. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
Lina Q: pinging — which modules are affected? any state moves?
Sam J: only module/gke-node-pool and module/common-iam. No state move. I left compatibility shims for the old output names for one release.
Chris M: sharing the provider change: in module/common-iam/providers.tf I'm adding:
```hcl
provider "google" {
  version = ">= 3.50, < 4.0"
}
```
Sam J: yes, exact. We had subtle behavior with 3.99 -> 4.0. Lockfile will be regenerated in the PR pipeline.
Lina Q: how does this interact with the k8s manifests / secret paths? I remember a rename in GKE secret path last sprint.
Sam J: good q — k8s secret path is unchanged, but GKE IAM patch requires a new annotation on node-pools. I added a small k8s manifest snippet in the PR that updates the daemonset.
Chris M: can you paste the manifest snippet here?
Sam J: sure
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-iam-patcher
  annotations:
    rwi.com/iam-patch: "v1"
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-iam-patcher
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: patcher
        image: ghcr.io/redwood/iam-patcher:sha-abcdef
        env:
        - name: SECRET_MOUNT_PATH
          value: "/etc/rwi/credentials"
```
Lina Q: ok, leaving the secret path alone is good. Any kubeconfig or rollout plan for staging? don't want to trigger a mass restart.
Sam J: rollout plan: apply daemonset in staging-1 via patch strategy (maxUnavailable: 1) then flip TF in staging to point to new module output. No simultaneous infra and deploy changes in prod.
Chris M: re: lockfile — CI will update it, but I'm adding a manual check to the pipeline to gate on lockfile drift. If the lockfile changes, CI will comment with the diff and require a manual approval.
Lina Q: can you add an lgtm tag for retention? I'll take the review once CI is green.
Sam J: added reviewers @LinaQ and @ChrisM. devops-bot: running plan now :gear:
devops-bot: Plan: 6 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy :white_check_mark:
Chris M: :eyes: looks small. Approving the approach. I'll wait for lockfile regen and a green smoke test before merging.
Sam J: thanks — merging after green. If anything unexpected, revert is "terraform state rm module.gke_node_pool.google_container_node_pool.node_pool" — but unlikely.
Lina Q: noted. Thanks for the clear rollout.
